summary: SEO indexing surface: robots.ts + sitemap.ts metadata routes + metadataBase
description: guru-ai.org is not indexed by Google (site: returns nothing). Diagnosis 2026-07-10: /sitemap.xml 404s (no sitemap exists), origin serves no robots.txt (Cloudflare injects content-signals boilerplate only, no Sitemap: line, no directives), layout metadata has no metadataBase so no absolute canonical/OG URLs. Public pages (/, /blog, /blog/[slug], /atlas) are clean — 200, no noindex. Fix: add src/app/robots.ts (allow public, disallow /api /sign-in /sign-up /chat /history /settings /account, Sitemap: line) and src/app/sitemap.ts (static routes + published post slugs via listPublishedCached), add metadataBase to root layout. GSC verification + sitemap submission remains a manual user step.

resolution.note: robots.ts + sitemap.ts metadata routes live, metadataBase set; GSC verification and sitemap submission remain a manual step
